printing_publishing_activity.label: Printing / publishing activity
printing_publishing_activity.value: Newspaper publishing through New York Post Media Group.

print_digital_revenue_mix_publishers.label: Print / digital revenue mix [publishers]
print_digital_revenue_mix_publishers.value: Digital subscriptions and advertising alongside print circulation and advertising. HarperCollins sells print books, e-books and audiobooks.

publication_print_market.label: Publication / print market
publication_print_market.value: General-interest newspapers through the New York Post.

advertising_circulation_dependence_publi.label: Advertising / circulation dependence [publishers]
advertising_circulation_dependence_publi.value: Dow Jones and News Media earn circulation and advertising revenue, including paid subscriptions and single-copy sales. HarperCollins earns revenue from book sales.

paid_circulation_periodicals.label: Paid circulation [periodicals]
paid_circulation_periodicals.value: Paid print and digital subscriptions for The Wall Street Journal, Barron’s, The Times and The Sunday Times.

rights_distribution_publishers.label: Rights / distribution [publishers]
rights_distribution_publishers.value: News brands distribute through their own websites and apps. HarperCollins acquires publishing rights from authors and distributes books through retailers.

notes: The companywide revenue split between print and digital is unclear.
